service_identification.Abstract: This is an OGC standards based Sensor Observation Service interface to Defra's UK Air Information Resource (UK-AIR). The service supports the UK obligations to European air quality e-Reporting initiative & Defra Open Data policy. The SOS provides a machine readable access point for air pollution measurements funded by Defra, Scottish Government, Welsh Government & Department of the Environment Northern Ireland. The service is INSPIRE network services compliant. For more on the European air quality e-Reporting initiative go to https://uk-air.defra.gov.uk/data/compliance-xml-files
